brand.subtitle: Authenticity check
brand.headline: Does this document really come from hocX?
brand.lead: Drop the PDF file. We compare its digital fingerprint with every document created with hocX.
brand.privacyNote: The file never leaves your device - only its fingerprint is checked.

verify.title: Verify authenticity
verify.hint: Check whether a PDF file comes unchanged from hocX.
verify.documentHint: Document {id} – drop the PDF file here to verify it.
verify.dropLabel: Drag the PDF file here or choose it
verify.dropOverlay: Release the file to verify it
verify.privacy: The file is not uploaded. Your browser computes its digital fingerprint (SHA-256) and sends only that for verification.
verify.originalText: This file is an unchanged copy of a document created with hocX on {date}.
verify.createdBy: Created in the hocX account of {name}.
verify.verifiedExplanation: hocX has confirmed that this account belongs to the organisation “{name}”.

verify.newerVersion: There is a newer version ({version}) of this document.
verify.notFoundText: This file does not match any document created with hocX. It has been modified or does not come from hocX.
verify.notFoundHint: Even saving again, “Print to PDF” or compressing changes the file, even if the content looks the same. Always check the file you originally received.

verify.readError: The file could not be read.
